quests.name: Things That Bite Back
desc: Catch the Pokémon nobody else wants.
Catch 4 Dark-, Ghost- or Poison-type Pokémon.

objs.text: Catch 4 Dark-, Ghost- or Poison-type Pokémon

quests.name: Black Market
desc: Pick ONE deal. Nobody asks where it came from.

quests.name: Black Market: Black Apricorns
desc: Hand it over. No questions.

quests.name: Black Market: Dusk Stone
desc: Hand it over. No questions.

quests.name: Black Market: Black Tumblestones
desc: Hand it over. No questions.

quests.name: Blackstone Tribute
desc: Bring useful stone to the shadow market.
Turn in 12 black tumblestones.

quests.name: Brawl in the Brush
desc: Pick a fight with any wild Pokémon that looks at you wrong.
Win 10 wild battles.

quests.name: Hellbound
desc: No borders, not even that one.
Catch 3 Pokémon in the Nether.

quests.name: Last Chance
desc: Duskvale plans for battles that go wrong.
Turn in 4 revives of any kind.

quests.name: Midnight Stock
desc: Duskvale favors tools made for the dark.
Turn in 8 Dusk Balls.

quests.name: Moonlit Ballsmith
desc: Build capture gear for hunts after sunset.
Craft 15 Poké Balls of any kind.

quests.name: Night Hunt
desc: Duskvale doesn't keep office hours.
Catch 5 Pokémon between dusk and dawn.

quests.name: Nobody's Leash
desc: Nobody tells Duskvale who to battle.
Win 2 Pokémon battles against other players.

quests.name: Ruthless Ambition
desc: Power is the only rule. Bring supplies worthy of Duskvale.
Hand in 8 Black Apricorns.

quests.name: Shadow Arsenal
desc: Dusk Balls work best when the lights go out.
Craft 8 Dusk Balls.

quests.name: Shadow Remedies
desc: Even ruthless trainers need a stocked medicine case.
Turn in 6 potions of any strength.

quests.name: Trial of Ruin
desc: Weekly trial. Three steps, in order:
fight, go where nobody should, pay up.
Big boost to Duskvale's points.

quests.name: Daily Catch
desc: Catch 3 Pokémon.
rewards: Random: Potion, Exp Candy XS, Oran Berry…

quests.name: Wild Training
desc: Win 5 battles against wild Pokémon.
rewards: Random: Potion, Exp Candy XS, Oran Berry…

quests.name: Apricorn Picking
desc: Pick apricorns from apricorn trees.
rewards: Random: Potion, Exp Candy XS, Oran Berry…

quests.name: Berry Gathering
desc: Collect berries from berry bushes.
rewards: Random: Potion, Exp Candy XS, Oran Berry…

quests.name: Ball Workshop
desc: Keep your bag stocked.
rewards: Random: Potion, Exp Candy XS, Oran Berry…

quests.name: Gym 7: Blaine
desc: Accept this quest, then challenge Gym Leader Blaine (the Fire-type leader).
Win the battle to earn the Volcano Badge.

quests.name: Gym 1: Brock
desc: Accept this quest, then challenge Gym Leader Brock (the Rock-type leader).
Win the battle to earn the Boulder Badge.

quests.name: Gym 8: Drayden
desc: Accept this quest, then challenge Gym Leader Drayden (the Dragon-type leader).
Win the battle to earn the Legend Badge.

quests.name: Gym 4: Gardenia
desc: Accept this quest, then challenge Gym Leader Gardenia (the Grass-type leader).
Win the battle to earn the Forest Badge.

quests.name: Gym 5: Koga
desc: Accept this quest, then challenge Gym Leader Koga (the Poison-type leader).
Win the battle to earn the Venom Badge.

quests.name: Gym 3: Lt. Surge
desc: Accept this quest, then challenge Gym Leader Lt. Surge (the Electric-type leader).
Win the battle to earn the Thunder Badge.

quests.name: Gym 2: Misty
desc: Accept this quest, then challenge Gym Leader Misty (the Water-type leader).
Win the battle to earn the Cascade Badge.

quests.name: Gym 6: Sabrina
desc: Accept this quest, then challenge Gym Leader Sabrina (the Psychic-type leader).
Win the battle to earn the Mind Badge.

quests.name: Growing Strong
desc: Raise any Pokémon to level 20.

quests.name: Collector
desc: Catch 50 Pokémon in total.

quests.name: Veteran Trainer
desc: Raise any Pokémon to level 50.

quests.name: Dex Hunter
desc: Catch 150 Pokémon in total.

quests.name: Apricorn Keeper
desc: Keep the groves productive for every trainer.
Turn in 10 apricorns of any color.

quests.name: Berry Patch
desc: Grow berries the whole region can share.
Plant 6 berries in the ground.

quests.name: Bloom Season
desc: Watch them grow up. Evolve 2 Pokémon.

quests.name: Forest Ballsmith
desc: Turn the harvest into tools for new journeys.
Craft 12 Poké Balls of any kind.

quests.name: Forest Kin
desc: Befriend the forest's own.
Catch 4 Grass- or Bug-type Pokémon.

quests.name: Got Your Back
desc: Stock the healers' shelf for anyone who needs it.

quests.name: Growing Together
desc: Raise your Pokémon a combined 15 levels.

quests.name: Healer's Duty
desc: Nobody heads out hurt.
Heal your party at a fully charged Healing Machine 3 times.

objs.text: Heal your party at a charged Healing Machine 3 times

quests.name: Healing Harvest
desc: Rootvale protects its own.
Deliver 6 potions for the regional clinic.

quests.name: Heart of Rootvale
desc: Weekly trial. Three steps, in order:
raise, grow, give.
Big boost to Rootvale's points.

quests.name: Home Grown
desc: Rootvale's roots run through the old forests.
Catch 3 Pokémon in any forest biome.

objs.text: Catch 3 Pokémon in a forest biome

quests.name: Open Pastures
desc: Home is where your Pokémon can roam.
Let Pokémon out of a Pasture Block 3 times.

objs.text: Let Pokémon out of a Pasture Block 3 times

quests.name: Apricorn Orchard
desc: Plant apricorn trees so every trainer has balls to craft.
Plant 5 Apricorn Seeds.

quests.name: Second Chance
desc: Prepare emergency supplies for injured partners.
Turn in 4 revives of any kind.

quests.name: Tend the Little Ones
desc: Healthy Pokémon start with someone who cares.
Use 10 items on your Pokémon:
candies, potions, berries, vitamins...

quests.name: Verdant Reserve
desc: Stock Rootvale’s communal stores.
Turn in 12 berries of any kind.

quests.name: Above the Clouds
desc: Climb higher than anyone bothers to.
Catch 3 Pokémon above Y 150.

quests.name: The Buried Past
desc: Dig up a fossil and show it off (you keep it).

quests.name: Coastline Survey
desc: Every landing starts at the shore.
Catch 3 Pokémon in ocean or beach biomes.

objs.text: Catch 3 Pokémon in ocean or beach biomes

quests.name: Deepwater Recovery
desc: Prepare recovery supplies before the next long voyage.
Turn in 4 revives of any kind.

quests.name: Expedition Stock
desc: Every survey team needs a full field kit.
Turn in 12 Poké Balls of any kind.

quests.name: Far-Flung Catch
desc: Sail past where the map stops.
Catch a Pokémon at least 3,000 blocks from spawn.

objs.text: Catch a Pokémon 3,000+ blocks from spawn

quests.name: Field Survey
desc: Log what lives out there. Catch 8 Pokémon.

quests.name: Forge Batch
desc: Supply the next expedition with fresh capture gear.
Craft 15 Poké Balls of any kind.

quests.name: Living History
desc: Bring something ancient back to life.
Revive a Pokémon in a Resurrection Machine.

quests.name: The Long Voyage
desc: Weekly trial. Three steps, in order:
sail out, uncover, document.
Big boost to Tideforge's points.

quests.name: Rescue Supplies
desc: A survey crew should never travel without medicine.
Deliver 6 potions to Tideforge.

quests.name: Rolling Stones
desc: Dig through suspicious sand and gravel for Tumblestones.

quests.name: Stone Salvage
desc: Recover useful material from the wilds.
Turn in 12 tumblestones of any type.

quests.name: Tides and Winds
desc: The sea and the sky are Tideforge's roads.
Catch 4 Water- or Flying-type Pokémon.

quests.name: The Long Voyage I: Sail Out

objs.text: Catch a Pokémon 6,000+ blocks from spawn

quests.name: Uncharted Habitats
desc: Find Pokémon where most trainers never go.
Your biome is picked when you accept.

objs.text: Catch a Pokémon in a Mushroom Fields biome

quests.name: Read the Rules
desc: Welcome to Snobblemon Regions, trainer!
Type /rules to open the server rules.
Read every page, then press I have read the rules.
Every other quest stays locked until this one is done.

objs.text: Read all of the server rules

quests.name: Pick Your Starter
desc: Welcome, trainer! Every journey starts with a partner.
Choose your starter Pokémon from the
starter screen that opens when you first join.
Press R to send it out, M to view its summary,
and the arrow keys to switch party slots.

quests.name: Your First Battle
desc: Look at a wild Pokémon and press R to throw out
your partner. That starts a battle!
Pick moves each turn. Win the battle.

objs.text: Win a battle against a wild Pokémon

quests.name: Gotta Catch One
desc: Weaken a wild Pokémon in battle, then throw a
Poké Ball at it (or throw one during the battle).
Lower HP = better catch chance. Catch any Pokémon.

quests.name: Apricorn Hunter
desc: Poké Balls are made from Apricorns.
Find an Apricorn tree (forests, plains) and
right-click a ripe Apricorn to pick it.

quests.name: Ball Crafter
desc: Craft your own Poké Balls from Apricorns.
Check the recipe book or JEI for the recipe.
Different Apricorn colors make different balls!

quests.name: Grow Your Own
desc: Never run out of Apricorns again.
Craft an Apricorn into Apricorn Seeds,
then plant one on dirt or grass.

quests.name: Pokémon Center at Home
desc: Fainted Pokémon need healing.
Craft a Healing Machine for your base.

quests.name: Heal Up
desc: The Healing Machine charges over time.
When it's fully charged, right-click it to
fully heal your whole party.

objs.text: Heal your party at a charged Healing Machine

quests.name: Box It Up
desc: You can only carry 6 Pokémon.
Craft a PC to store the rest.
Right-click it to swap Pokémon in and out.

quests.name: Berry Forager
desc: Berries grow wild on bushes all over the world.
They heal Pokémon, cure status, and more.
Pick any Berry.

quests.name: Berry Farmer
desc: Plant a Berry in the ground to grow a Berry tree.
Planting different Berries next to each other
can create new ones (mutations)!

quests.name: Medicinal Leek
desc: Medicinal Leeks grow wild near water.
They're the base of all Pokémon medicine.
Pick one.

quests.name: Local Apothecary
desc: Brew a Medicinal Leek in a Brewing Stand
to make Medicinal Brew.

quests.name: Potion Master
desc: Brew an Oran Berry into Medicinal Brew
to make a Potion.

quests.name: Take Care of Them
desc: Right-click with a Potion, Berry or candy and
choose a Pokémon to use it on.

objs.text: Use an item on one of your Pokémon

quests.name: Training Day
desc: Pokémon gain experience from battles.
Exp. Candy gives instant experience.
Raise any Pokémon to level 10.

quests.name: Evolution!
desc: Most Pokémon evolve when they reach a level,
some need a stone, friendship or a trade.
When one is ready, evolve it from the summary (M).

quests.name: Power Training
desc: You have learned how levels work.
Bring 3 Exp. Candy S to prepare for tougher training.

quests.name: Room to Roam
desc: Craft a Pasture Block and place it.
Right-click it to let your Pokémon out to
wander around your base.

objs.text: Let a Pokémon out of a Pasture Block

quests.name: Full House
desc: Build a full team.
Have 6 Pokémon in your party at once.

quests.name: Gone Fishing
desc: Some Pokémon live underwater.
Make a Poké Rod at a Smithing Table
(fishing rod + Poké Ball), then cast it in water.

quests.name: The Rolling Stone
desc: Brush Suspicious Sand or Gravel to dig up
Tumblestones, used to craft Ancient Poké Balls.

quests.name: Consult the Fossil
desc: Fossils are buried deep underground and in
ruins. Find one.

quests.name: Life Finds a Way
desc: Build a Resurrection Machine and bring
your Fossil Pokémon back to life.

quests.name: Trading Partner
desc: Trade a Pokémon with another player.
Some Pokémon only evolve when traded!

objs.text: Trade a Pokémon with another trainer

quests.name: Friendly Rival
desc: Challenge another player to a Pokémon battle
and win. (Look at them and press R.)

objs.text: Win a Pokémon battle against a player

quests.name: Graduation
desc: You know the basics. Welcome to Snobblemon!
Region quests are waiting for you.

categories.name: Trainer's Tutorial
desc: New to Cobblemon? Start here.
Each step teaches one thing and unlocks the next.
Rewards help you with the next step.

categories.name: Trainer's Journey
desc: Daily tasks and long-term goals for every trainer.

categories.name: Rootvale
desc: Home. Build, explore, and raise your Pokémon
alongside people who have your back.
Only Rootvale members can accept these.

categories.name: Duskvale
desc: Answers to nobody.
Fight, break things, and take what you want.
Only Duskvale members can accept these.

categories.name: Tideforge
desc: Built by explorers, for explorers.
Push past the map's edge and claim what you find.
Only Tideforge members can accept these.
